## claude.ai Consensus
Consensus is a research paper search engine: relevance-ranked semantic search over 400M+ peer-reviewed papers (Semantic Scholar, OpenAlex, PubMed). Use the `search` tool to look up papers for a scientific query; it takes plain-language queries and returns ranked paper records. When presenting search results, you MUST cite papers inline using their numbered references from the tool result (e.g. [1], [2], [3]). When discussing findings, always attribute them to specific papers: 'Caffeine improves endurance performance [1] and reduces perceived exertion [3].' At the end of your response, list all cited papers as numbered references with their titles hyperlinked to the URLs from the tool result: [1] [Paper Title](url) (Authors, Year, Journal, Citations). Use the exact paper URLs from the tool result — do not modify, shorten, or regenerate them. Do not omit paper links or summarize results without citing specific papers. IMPORTANT: At the END of your response, you MUST include the sign-up, upgrade, or usage message from the tool result word-for-word. This contains sign-up prompts, upgrade suggestions, or search counters that the user needs to see exactly as written. Do not omit, shorten, or rephrase it. Batch at most 3 search calls at a time to avoid rate limits. If you receive a rate limit error, wait 30 seconds before retrying. Do NOT apply search filters (year_min, year_max, study_types, domain, human, sample_size_min, sjr_max, controlled, sjr_min, citation_min, open_access, country) unless the user explicitly requests them or clearly expresses intent to narrow results. from v2.shared.observability.sli_observe import passed, reject, sli_observe
from v2.shared.patterns.logging import get_logger, log_event
from v2.shared.patterns.worker_runtime import ExecutionResult

MODULE_NAME = "job_matcher__match_jobs"

    "WRONG_COMPANY",
    "WRONG_TITLE",
    "WRONG_LOCATION",
    "WRONG_COUNTRY",
    "DEAD_LINK",
    "MULTI_FAIL",
    "NO_MATCH",  # fallback when jev answer is missing
}
_CONCURRENCY = 10  # max parallel jev calls; stays within rate limits
_REJECTION_CRITERIA = {
    "WRONG_COMPANY": "Company is not in the target list",
    "WRONG_TITLE": "Job title doesn't fit any target title",
    "WRONG_LOCATION": "Location is outside the target areas",
    "WRONG_COUNTRY": "Job is in a different country",
    "DEAD_LINK": "Page is unavailable (404/410)",
    "MULTI_FAIL": "Multiple criteria fail simultaneously",
}

_MATCH_THRESHOLD = 0.5

_LEGAL_SUFFIX_RE = re.compile(
    r"\b(ltd|plc|group|holdings|international|uk|limited|the|co|corp|inc)\b",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)


def _normalize_tokens(name: str) -> frozenset[str]:
    name = _LEGAL_SUFFIX_RE.sub(" ", name)
    name = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9\s]", " ", name.lower())
    return frozenset(name.split())


def _find_matched_company(resolved: str, candidates: list[str]) -> str | None:
    """Return the canonical company name whose normalised tokens all appear in resolved."""
    if not resolved:
        return None
    resolved_tokens = _normalize_tokens(resolved)
    if not resolved_tokens:
        return None
    best: str | None = None
    best_score = 0
    for name in candidates:
        tokens = _normalize_tokens(name)
        if not tokens:
            continue
        overlap = len(tokens & resolved_tokens)
        if overlap == len(tokens) and overlap > best_score:
            best = name
            best_score = overlap
    return best


def _job_state(row: dict) -> dict:
    page = row.get("page") or {}
    sj = page.get("structured_job") or {}
    return {
        "company": row.get("resolved_company") or row.get("company") or sj.get("company") or "",
        "title": row.get("resolved_title") or row.get("title") or sj.get("title") or "",
        "location_strings": row.get("location_strings") or [],
        "is_remote": bool(row.get("is_remote_hint")),
        "title_tag": (page.get("title_tag") or "")[:120],
        "url": (row.get("source_url") or "")[:100],
    }


def _get_rejection_reason(answers: dict) -> str:
    ans = answers.get("rejection_reason")
    if ans and ans.choice in REJECTION_REASONS:
        return ans.choice
    return "NO_MATCH"


def _build_questions(companies: list[str], titles: list[str], locations: list[dict]) -> dict:
    questions: dict = {}

    # Company: NoulQuestion — avoids jev's 255-option cap on ChoiceQuestion.
    # Canonical name is resolved locally via _find_matched_company after the call.
    company_list_text = "\n".join(f"- {name}" for name in companies)
    questions["company"] = NoulQuestion(
        instructions=(
            "Does this job belong to one of the following target companies? "
            "Ignore case, punctuation, legal suffixes (Ltd, plc, Group, Holdings, Corp, UK), "
            "and a leading 'The'. Consider the company name in title_tag, url, and title.\n"
            f"Target companies:\n{company_list_text}"
        ),
        criteria={"true": "Job belongs to a target company", "false": "No target company match"},
    )

    for i, title in enumerate(titles):
        questions[f"title_{i}"] = NoulQuestion(
            instructions=(
                f"Does the job title contain every word from '{title}'? "
                "Word order doesn't matter; ignore case and punctuation; treat trailing 's' as plural."
            ),
            criteria={"true": f"Job title matches '{title}'", "false": f"Job title does NOT match '{title}'"},
        )

        name = loc["name"]
        loc_type = loc.get("type", "")
        includes = loc.get("includes") or []
        country = loc.get("country", "United Kingdom")
        if loc_type == "remote":
            instruction = f"Is this job declared as remote or home-based work in {country} ('{name}')?"

            instructions=instruction,
            criteria={"true": f"Job is in '{name}'", "false": f"Job is NOT in '{name}'"},

    questions["rejection_reason"] = ChoiceQuestion(
        instructions=(
            "If this job does NOT fully match all three criteria (company + title + location), "
            "what is the single most important reason?"
        ),
        criteria=_REJECTION_CRITERIA,
    )

    return questions


async def _process_row(
    sem: asyncio.Semaphore,
    row: dict,
    questions: dict,
    companies: list,
    titles: list,
    locations: list,
    logger,
    trace_id: str,
) -> None:

        return
    matched_company = _find_matched_company(_job_state(row)["company"], companies)
    if not matched_company:

    matched_titles = [
        titles[i] for i in range(len(titles)) if (a := answers.get(f"title_{i}")) and a.noul > _MATCH_THRESHOLD

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
import os
from typing import Any

LOG_FORMAT = "%(asctime)s | %(levelname)s | %(name)s | %(message)s"


def get_logger(name: str) -> logging.Logger:
    """A logger named after the module (MODULE_NAME) or handler (HANDLER_NAME); level from LOG_LEVEL."""
    logging.basicConfig(level=os.environ.get("LOG_LEVEL", "INFO"), format=LOG_FORMAT)
    return logging.getLogger(name)


def log_event(logger: logging.Logger, level: str, event: str, trace_id: str, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
    """One structured log line: {"event": ..., "trace_id": ..., **kwargs}. Facts only, never row totals."""
    getattr(logger, level)(json.dumps({"event": event, "trace_id": trace_id, **kwargs}, default=str))

from v2.shared.observability.sli_observe import passed, reject, sli_observe

    "WRONG_COUNTRY",
    "DEAD_LINK",
    "MULTI_FAIL",

}

    "WRONG_TITLE": "Job title doesn't fit any target title",
    "WRONG_LOCATION": "Location is outside the target areas",
    "WRONG_COUNTRY": "Job is in a different country",
    "DEAD_LINK": "Page is unavailable (404/410)",
    "MULTI_FAIL": "Multiple criteria fail simultaneously",
}

    r"\b(ltd|plc|group|holdings|international|uk|limited|the|co|corp|inc)\b",

)

    name = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9\s]", " ", name.lower())

    """Return the canonical company name whose normalised tokens all appear in resolved."""
    if not resolved:
        return None
    resolved_tokens = _normalize_tokens(resolved)
    if not resolved_tokens:
        return None
    best: str | None = None
    best_score = 0
    for name in candidates:
        tokens = _normalize_tokens(name)
        if not tokens:
            continue
        overlap = len(tokens & resolved_tokens)
        if overlap == len(tokens) and overlap > best_score:
            best = name
            best_score = overlap
    return best


def _job_state(row: dict) -> dict:
    page = row.get("page") or {}
    sj = page.get("structured_job") or {}
    return {
        "company": row.get("resolved_company") or row.get("company") or sj.get("company") or "",
        "title": row.get("resolved_title") or row.get("title") or sj.get("title") or "",
        "location_strings": row.get("location_strings") or [],
        "is_remote": bool(row.get("is_remote_hint")),
        "title_tag": (page.get("title_tag") or "")[:120],
        "url": (row.get("source_url") or "")[:100],
    }


def _get_rejection_reason(answers: dict) -> str:
    ans = answers.get("rejection_reason")
    if ans and ans.choice in REJECTION_REASONS:
        return ans.choice
    return "NO_MATCH"


def _build_questions(companies: list[str], titles: list[str], locations: list[dict]) -> dict:
    questions: dict = {}

    # Canonical name is resolved locally via _find_matched_company after the call.
    company_list_text = "\n".join(f"- {name}" for name in companies)
    questions["company"] = NoulQuestion(
        instructions=(
            "Does this job belong to one of the following target companies? "
            "Ignore case, punctuation, legal suffixes (Ltd, plc, Group, Holdings, Corp, UK), "
            "and a leading 'The'. Consider the company name in title_tag, url, and title.\n"
            f"Target companies:\n{company_list_text}"
        ),
        criteria={"true": "Job belongs to a target company", "false": "No target company match"},
    )

    # Titles: one NoulQuestion per target title
    for i, title in enumerate(titles):
        questions[f"title_{i}"] = NoulQuestion(
            instructions=(
                f"Does the job title contain every word from '{title}'? "
                "Word order doesn't matter; ignore case and punctuation; treat trailing 's' as plural."
            ),
            criteria={"true": f"Job title matches '{title}'", "false": f"Job title does NOT match '{title}'"},
        )

    # Locations: one NoulQuestion per target location
    for i, loc in enumerate(locations):
        name = loc["name"]
        loc_type = loc.get("type", "")
        includes = loc.get("includes") or []
        country = loc.get("country", "United Kingdom")
        if loc_type == "remote":
            instruction = f"Is this job declared as remote or home-based work in {country} ('{name}')?"
        else:
            inc_str = f" Includes: {', '.join(includes)}." if includes else ""
            instruction = f"Is this job located in '{name}' ({loc_type}) in {country}?{inc_str}"
        questions[f"loc_{i}"] = NoulQuestion(
            instructions=instruction,
            criteria={"true": f"Job is in '{name}'", "false": f"Job is NOT in '{name}'"},
        )

    # Rejection reason: asked alongside match questions for granular SLI tracking
    questions["rejection_reason"] = ChoiceQuestion(
        instructions=(
            "If this job does NOT fully match all three criteria (company + title + location), "
            "what is the single most important reason?"
        ),
        criteria=_REJECTION_CRITERIA,
    )

    row: dict,
    questions: dict,
    companies: list,
    titles: list,
    locations: list,
    logger,
    trace_id: str,
) -> None:
    async with sem:
        try:
            answers = await decide_async(_job_state(row), questions, purpose="job_matching")
        except BudgetExceeded:
            raise
        except Exception as exc:
            log_event(logger, "error", "llm_job_failed", trace_id, error=str(exc), job_id=row.get("job_id"))
            row["META_ERROR_REASON"] = "LLM_ERROR"
            return

    rejection_reason = _get_rejection_reason(answers)

    company_ans = answers.get("company")
    if not company_ans or company_ans.noul <= _MATCH_THRESHOLD:
        reject(row, rejection_reason)
        return
    matched_company = _find_matched_company(_job_state(row)["company"], companies)
    if not matched_company:
        reject(row, rejection_reason)
        return

    matched_titles = [
        titles[i] for i in range(len(titles)) if (a := answers.get(f"title_{i}")) and a.noul > _MATCH_THRESHOLD
    ]
    if not matched_titles:
        reject(row, rejection_reason)
        return

    matched_locs = [
        locations[i]["name"]
        for i in range(len(locations))
        if (a := answers.get(f"loc_{i}")) and a.noul > _MATCH_THRESHOLD
    ]
    if not matched_locs:
        reject(row, rejection_reason)
        return

    row["matched_company"] = matched_company
    row["matched_job_title"] = matched_titles
    row["matched_location"] = matched_locs
    row["reason"] = f"jev: company={matched_company}, titles={matched_titles}, locations={matched_locs}"
    row["used_llm"] = True

    rows: list[dict],
    questions: dict,
    companies: list,
    titles: list,
    locations: list,
    logger,
    trace_id: str,
) -> None:
    sem = asyncio.Semaphore(_CONCURRENCY)
    await asyncio.gather(
        *[_process_row(sem, row, questions, companies, titles, locations, logger, trace_id) for row in rows]
    )


def main(context: dict, prev_data: list[dict]) -> ExecutionResult:
    trace_id: str = context.get("trace_id") or ""
    start_time = time.time()
    logger = get_logger(MODULE_NAME)

    profile = context["profile"]
    companies = [c["name"] if isinstance(c, dict) else c for c in profile.get("companies") or []]
    titles = profile.get("titles") or []
    locations = profile.get("locations") or []

    questions = _build_questions(companies, titles, locations)

    asyncio.run(_process_all(prev_data, questions, companies, titles, locations, logger, trace_id))

    sli_observe(prev_data, MODULE_NAME, start_time, trace_id)
    return ExecutionResult(
        trace_id=trace_id,
        script_span_id=f"{MODULE_NAME}_{trace_id}",
        data=passed(prev_data),
        artifacts={},
        metrics={},
    )

def run_parallel_pipeline(jobs_path: Path, search_inputs_dir: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Load all jobs once, run parallel normalization+agent per recruiter, then output."""
    trace_id = new_trace_id()
    logger = get_logger(HANDLER_NAME)
    rd = run_dir(trace_id)
    llm.start_run(rd)
    log_event(logger, "info", "run_started", trace_id, jobs_path=str(jobs_path))

    stage_clean_jobs = importlib.import_module("v2.workers.job_matcher.stages.stage_clean_jobs")
    stage_output = importlib.import_module("v2.workers.job_matcher.stages.stage_output")
    stage_report = importlib.import_module("v2.workers.job_matcher.stages.stage_report")
    chunk_runner = importlib.import_module("v2.workers.job_matcher.chunk_runner")

    outputs: dict[str, str] = {}
    for prefix, profile in load_search_inputs(Path(search_inputs_dir)):

    for path, count in run_parallel_pipeline(args.jobs, args.search_inputs).items():
        print(f"{count:>5} matches -> {path}")

SEARCH_INPUT_FILES = {"companies": "company_searches.json", "titles": "job_title_searches.json",
                      "locations": "location_searches.json"}  # fmt: skip


@dataclass
class ExecutionResult:
    """What every module and stage returns: the rows for the next step, plus named artifacts (e.g. a file path)."""

    trace_id: str
    script_span_id: str
    data: list[dict]
    artifacts: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    metrics: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class StageDefinition:
    """One node of a STAGE_GRAPH: a stage (in a handler) or a module (in a stage), by dotted module path."""

    name: str
    module_path: str


def new_trace_id() -> str:
    """Run timestamp, also the run's folder name under runs/."""
    return f"{datetime.now(timezone.utc):%Y%m%dT%H%M%S}"


def run_dir(trace_id: str) -> Path:
    """runs/<trace_id>/ (ILLUMINI_RUNS_DIR overrides runs/), created on first use."""
    path = Path(os.environ.get("ILLUMINI_RUNS_DIR", "runs")) / trace_id
    path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return path


def debug_limits() -> tuple[bool, int]:
    """(DEBUG_MODE, DEBUG_LOOPS) from the environment: big loops stop after DEBUG_LOOPS rows in debug mode."""
    return os.environ.get("DEBUG_MODE", "false").lower() == "true", int(os.environ.get("DEBUG_LOOPS", "5"))


def validate_context(context: dict, schema: dict) -> None:
    """Raise ValueError when a non-nullable field is missing or a field has the wrong type."""
    for name, spec in schema["fields"].items():
        value = context.get(name)
        if value is None:
            if not spec["nullable"]:
                raise ValueError(f"context schema {schema['version']}: {name!r} is required")
        elif not isinstance(value, spec["type"]):
            raise ValueError(f"context schema {schema['version']}: {name!r} must be {spec['type'].__name__}")


def run_stage_loop(
    stage_name: str, stage_graph: dict[str, StageDefinition], context: dict, prev_data: list[dict]
) -> ExecutionResult:
    """Run each module in STAGE_GRAPH order, feeding each one the previous module's data."""
    data, artifacts = prev_data, {}
    for node in stage_graph.values():
        result = importlib.import_module(node.module_path).main(context, data)
        data = result.data
        artifacts.update(result.artifacts)
    return ExecutionResult(
        trace_id=context["trace_id"],
        script_span_id=f"{stage_name}_{context['trace_id']}",
        data=data,
        artifacts=artifacts,
        metrics={},
    )


def load_search_inputs(root: Path) -> list[tuple[str, dict]]:
    """(output prefix, profile) per recruiter. Each recruiter is a folder of three search files:
    company_searches.json {"profile_id", "companies"}, job_title_searches.json {"profile_id", "titles"} and
    location_searches.json {"profile_id", "locations"}, read back into one profile. A missing file or a
    profile_id that differs between the three raises. A plain <prefix>.json profile (the older layout) still loads."""
    profiles: list[tuple[str, dict]] = []
    for folder in sorted(p for p in root.iterdir() if p.is_dir()):
        present = {field: folder / name for field, name in SEARCH_INPUT_FILES.items() if (folder / name).exists()}
        if not present:
            continue
        if len(present) != len(SEARCH_INPUT_FILES):
            missing = sorted(set(SEARCH_INPUT_FILES.values()) - {p.name for p in present.values()})
            raise ValueError(f"{folder}: missing search input files {missing}")
        parts = {field: json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) for field, path in present.items()}
        ids = {part["profile_id"] for part in parts.values()}
        if len(ids) != 1:
            raise ValueError(f"{folder}: profile_id differs across the search input files: {sorted(ids)}")
        profiles.append((folder.name, {"profile_id": ids.pop(), **{f: parts[f][f] for f in SEARCH_INPUT_FILES}}))
    for path in sorted(root.glob("*.json")):
        profiles.append((path.stem, json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))))
    return profiles


def run_pipeline(
    stage_graph: dict[str, StageDefinition],
    input_schema: dict,
    output_schema: dict,
    handler_name: str,
    jobs_path: Path,
    search_inputs_dir: Path,
) -> dict[str, str]:
    """One trace per call; one "message" per recruiter in search_inputs_dir. Returns {output file: listed job count}."""
    trace_id = new_trace_id()
    logger = get_logger(handler_name)
    llm.start_run(run_dir(trace_id))
    log_event(logger, "info", "run_started", trace_id, jobs_path=str(jobs_path),
              search_inputs_dir=str(search_inputs_dir))  # fmt: skip
    outputs: dict[str, str] = {}
    for prefix, profile in load_search_inputs(Path(search_inputs_dir)):
        context = {
            "trace_id": trace_id,
            "jobs_path": str(jobs_path),
            "profile": profile,
            "profile_id": profile["profile_id"],
            "output_prefix": prefix,
        }
        validate_context(context, input_schema)
        data: list[dict] = []
        for node in stage_graph.values():
            result = importlib.import_module(node.module_path).main(context, data)
            data = result.data
            context.update(result.artifacts)
        validate_context(context, output_schema)
        outputs[context["output_path"]] = str(len(data))
    log_event(logger, "info", "run_finished", trace_id, outputs=outputs, llm_spent_gbp=round(llm.spent_gbp(), 4))
    return outputs


def run_local_handler(
    stage_graph: dict[str, StageDefinition], input_schema: dict, output_schema: dict, handler_name: str
) -> int:
    """Entry point for `python -m <handler module>`: parse --jobs / --search-inputs, run, print one line per output."""
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog=handler_name)
    parser.add_argument("--jobs", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_JOBS)
    parser.add_argument("--search-inputs", "--briefs", dest="search_inputs", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_SEARCH_INPUTS)
    args, _ = parser.parse_known_args()
    for path, count in run_pipeline(
        stage_graph, input_schema, output_schema, handler_name, args.jobs, args.search_inputs
    ).items():
        print(f"{count:>5} matches -> {path}")
    return 0

"""Remove jobs with dead HTTP links (404 or 410) before any resolution work."""

from __future__ import annotations

import time

from v2.shared.observability.sli_observe import passed, reject, sli_observe
from v2.shared.patterns.logging import get_logger, log_event
from v2.shared.patterns.worker_runtime import ExecutionResult

MODULE_NAME = "job_matcher__filter_dead_links"
MODULE_TYPE = "filter"
# 404/410: explicitly dead; 403/405: blocked — page unreadable, job unverifiable
REJECTION_REASONS = {"DEAD_LINK", "BLOCKED_PAGE"}
ERROR_REASONS: set[str] = set()
WARNING_REASONS: set[str] = set()

_DEAD_STATUSES = frozenset({404, 410})
_BLOCKED_STATUSES = frozenset({403, 405})


logger = get_logger(MODULE_NAME)


def main(context: dict, prev_data: list[dict]) -> ExecutionResult:
    """Reject rows whose page could not be confirmed: dead (404/410) or blocked (403/405)."""
    trace_id: str = context.get("trace_id")
    start_time = time.time()
    log_event(logger, "info", "module_start", trace_id, input_count=len(prev_data))

    for row in prev_data:
        try:
            page = row.get("page") or {}
            status = page.get("http_status")
            if status in _DEAD_STATUSES:
                reject(row, "DEAD_LINK")
                continue
            if status in _BLOCKED_STATUSES:
                reject(row, "BLOCKED_PAGE")
                continue
            # Page rendered but no structured content at all — job is unverifiable
            sj = page.get("structured_job") or {}
            if not sj.get("title") and not (page.get("h1") or "").strip() and not sj.get("company"):
                reject(row, "BLOCKED_PAGE")
        except Exception as exc:
            log_event(logger, "error", "row_error", trace_id, job_id=row.get("job_id"), error=str(exc))

    kept = passed(prev_data)
    log_event(logger, "info", "module_done", trace_id, kept=len(kept), dropped=len(prev_data) - len(kept))
    sli_observe(prev_data, MODULE_NAME, start_time, trace_id)
    return ExecutionResult(
        trace_id=trace_id,
        script_span_id=f"{MODULE_NAME}_{trace_id}",
        data=kept,
        artifacts={},
        metrics={},
    )
